description: This file implements SSH tunnel management, including parsing SSH target strings, port allocation, connectivity checks, and starting/stopping SSH port forwarding using child processes.

methods.name: parseSshTarget
methods.description: Parses an SSH target string into an object with user, host, and port, with validation and security checks.

methods.name: startSshPortForward
methods.description: Initiates an SSH port forwarding session with specified options, manages process lifecycle, and handles errors.
